hypothesis: The v1 task-specific programs were truncated while every sixth greedy step still improved. Extending the exact source-position greedy search to ten components will recover more of the distributed circuit without changing the frozen pool or using heldout outcomes for selection.

frozen_design.candidate_pool: The same 20 pre-outcome weight-frozen top/bottom attention-head and MLP candidates per task as v1.
frozen_design.fit: The same jointly capable A1 fit rows only: 16 has/had and 8 is/was.
frozen_design.sealed_incremental_evaluation: A1 heldout and A2; prefixes 7-10 are new interventions, while prior singleton/prefix evidence remains descriptive context.
frozen_design.objective: Greedily minimize rowwise MSE to unit donor recovery.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_exact_instru: All panels remain capable with exact carrier widths.
predictions.pred_b_both_greedy_paths_are_distributiv: Both paths select 2-10 components with strict fit improvement at every accepted step.
predictions.pred_c_both_paths_generalize_to_a1: Both heldout A1 panels have recovery at least 0.70, direction at least 0.80, and beat the best singleton.
predictions.pred_d_both_paths_transfer_to_a2: Both A2 panels have recovery at least 0.65, direction at least 0.80, and beat the best singleton.
predictions.pred_e_shared_program_machinery: At least two labels are shared across task programs.
predictions.pred_f_price_and_coverage: At most 438 forwards, 5845 example evaluations, and 5663 intervention records.
predictions.pred_g_truncation_was_active: Both paths select at least seven components.
predictions.pred_h_extended_paths_improve_prior_reco: Each panel's mean recovery is no lower than its v1 value: has 0.736264936/0.742626401 and is 0.654259641/0.804755353 for heldout/A2.

decision: screen only if every prediction passes; null on scientific failure; invalid on authority, capability, instrument, coverage, or price failure
heldout_policy: Only A1 fit chooses components; no heldout or A2 outcome changes the path.
